findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2025 年無單一客戶占合併營收逾 10%，但公司常態為最大客戶承建專案，失去任一者可能有重大不利影響；一手文件未提及客戶導入第二供應商或 in-house。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, no individual customer accounted for more than 10% of our consolidated revenues; however we routinely construct projects for our largest customers mentioned above. The loss of any of these customers could have a material adverse effect on our business and financial results.
